utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. Madam Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-95-9-A, the Prosecutor versus Blagoje Simic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Simic, can you tell me if you're able to listen to the proceedings and to follow the proceedings. Thank you. May I have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. GOY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Barbara Goy appearing for the Prosecution, together with Senior Appeals Counsel, Mr. Norm Farrell, and our case manager, Ms. Susan Grogan.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] Let me turn to the Defence of Mr. Simic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Pantelic, I represent Blagoje Simic, Dr. Blagoje Simic, and today with me I have my co-counsel who is going to introduce himself. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Peter Murphy for the accused.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Under Rule 75 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, a Status Conference has to be convened 120 days within the filing of the notice of appeal, and then every 120 days thereafter, to give the opportunity to the person detained and waiting for an appeal judgement the opportunity to raise any issues related to their proceedings. In the present case, Mr. Simic filed his notice of appeal against the judgement delivered against him on the 17th of October, 2003. All pleadings related to the appeals proceeding have been filed, and this is the fourth Status Conference convened in this appeals proceedings. One of the objectives of this Status Conference is to allow Mr. Simic to raise any concerns he might have regarding his detention conditions or to his physical or mental state. Mr. Simic, would you or your counsel address the Chamber about any concerns related to these issues.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I believe that my client will talk to you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You have the floor, Mr. Simic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have nothing to raise in regard to my stay in detention, nothing specific to mention or any objections to raise. I just wish to thank you for having allowed me to be released to visit the grave of my father. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You can sit down. Let's now talk about the status of the appeals proceedings in this case. All written submissions related to the appeal have been filed, and no application from the parties is pending before the Chamber. In terms of the proceedings, I'd like to inform the parties that the decision related to the application filed by Franko Simatovic requesting access to documents in the Bosanski Samac case will be delivered in the next few days. Finally, I would like to state that the date for the appeals hearings has not been set yet by the Appeals Chamber. This being said, I have no other issues to address. However, I would like to turn to the parties to ask them if they want to make any comments or raise any issues. Madam Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: MS. GOY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. No, there is nothing we would like to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Mr. Pantelic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, same thing for the Defence; we do not have any issues to raise before the Chamber. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. [In English] I see none. [Interpretation] Since there aren't any other issues for us to consider, this Status Conference stands now adjourned.
